description: rlandfire is an R interface to the US LANDFIRE Product Service maintained by the package contributors. It queries and prepares spatial layers for vegetation, fuels, disturbance and related wildfire modelling inputs from the provider's API. Users specify a product, area and date or version where available; outputs are R-accessible raster or vector layers for that extent. Geographic coverage is the United States areas served by LANDFIRE, and time coverage depends on each product version. GPL-3.0 package source, CRAN installation and a worked canopy-change example are public. The upstream LANDFIRE layers retain their own data terms, separate from the R code. A limitation is that a fetched fuel layer can be stale or too coarse for an individual transmission line or building, so local verification remains necessary. rlandfire can prepare wildfire-exposure inputs for power, roads and settlements. The catalogue's data-effis is a separate European fire service, not the same US source. No LANDFIRE raster or package was downloaded.
